stem: A temperature sensor fails in one flower room for a defined two-hour period. Which first-pass scope is most defensible?
choices: Assume every crop in the facility was affected
Identify the room, time period, connected lots and records before expanding the scope based on evidence
Ignore the event because the sensor stopped recording
Place all future harvests on indefinite hold
rationale: Traceable room, time and lot information helps define the plausible affected scope rather than assuming either no impact or facility-wide impact without evidence.
